prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions tended to overestimate positive impact overall (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in winning tests during rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests in rounds 3 and 4.
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests in rounds 4 and 6, though 3 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 2, and 5).
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 1 and 5).
home notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 2 and 6).
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, and finish new_screen because their tests disagree, as well as for choose_path copy, choose_path new_flow, finish copy, and sign_in reorder with only one test each.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -2.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +3.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, new_flow: -5.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +3.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -4.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, notification: +0.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.6% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +2.2% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 75.6%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 28.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Controls Carousel During Render: Display an interactive tip carousel on the waiting screen showing keyboard shortcuts to hide, move, and summon the pet while rendering finishes. (why: Home wait time is high (median 201s) and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Actions Overview Screen: Add a dedicated post-intro screen 'new_desktop_quick_actions' showing visual callouts for desktop tray icons, sound toggles, and pet interaction menus. (why: Users struggle post-onboarding with controlling, hiding, or talking to their pets (3 support emails) and overall onboarding completion is only 28.5%.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Safety Hint: Display a prominent reassurance hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that signing in preserves pet customization and prevents account resets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account persistence assurance essential during sign-in.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Generation Quality Verification Sub-Flow: Insert a photo preview validation screen 'new_photo_quality_check' to ensure uploaded photos meet background removal and render requirements. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or weird visual results, causing frustration during the 1017s mean adoption phase.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selector Stage Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen with a stage layout, showing interactive companion choice cards and clear time expectations for preset vs custom paths. (why: Choose path has a mean time of 514s due to decision friction, and redesigning with stage layout provides immediate visual clarity.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Story Welcome Journey Time Expectations Copy: Update headline and body copy on the initial story screen to set clear time expectations for completing onboarding. (why: Users take long mean times across all onboarding steps (e.g. 514s choose_path, 567s sign_in), leading to drop-offs before completion.)
6: [finish, hint] Taskbar & Visibility Hint on Home Welcome: Add an explicit hint on home_intro screen telling users how to find the desktop app tray icon if the pet window closes. (why: 3 support tickets noted that the pet does not show on desktop or the app will not open after setup.)
7: [home, wait_info] Live Rendering Estimated Time Progress Bar: Enable progress bar and time estimate display on the waiting screen while background assets compile. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s; previous lessons showed home wait_info changes are effective backed by wins in rounds 3 & 4.)
8: [adoption, hint] Upload Guidance Hint for Custom Pet Creation: Add a clear upload guideline hint on the upload_photos screen explaining ideal lighting and framing for custom pets. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect during adoption generation.)

scores.note: Proven home wait_info pattern; directly addresses 3 support emails on pet control confusion.
High effort new screen; finish new_screen changes historically performed poorly (-4.7% avg).
Backed by 8 support emails and sign_in hints have a strong positive track record (+2.2% avg).
Targets highest drop step, but adding sub-flows and redesigns in adoption step has negative historic returns.
High implementation cost with layout/redesign tests on choose_path showing no clear benefit.
Low cost copy tweak; single prior choose_path copy test was positive (+3.9%).
Low-cost hint addressing 3 support tickets regarding post-setup window visibility.
Proven wait_info pattern for high wait time bottleneck (201s median / 2336s mean).
Targets largest drop-off step (adoption, 33.8% loss) using low-friction hint guidance.
